class.name: SteamLobbyEdit
class.brief_description: Stages display metadata for one exact Steam lobby membership.

method.name: named
method.description: Return a branch staging a display name of up to 127 UTF-8 bytes. An empty name clears the current name.

method.name: tag
method.description: Return a branch staging a key of 1 to 32 ASCII letters, numbers, underscores or hyphens and a value up to 255 UTF-8 bytes. Keys starting with [code]crimson_[/code], including case variants, are reserved. An empty value clears the tag.

method.name: submit
method.description: Recheck Steam's current owner and submit up to 16 distinct staged keys. [constant OK] means each write was accepted. Steam may accept earlier keys before a later write fails. Invalid or empty edits return [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER], closed membership returns [constant ERR_UNAVAILABLE], and guests receive [constant ERR_UNAUTHORIZED].
